repos_data.description: Powerful menu bar manager for macOS
Free and open-source macOS menu bar toolkit.
A powerful cross-platform port management tool for developers. Monitor ports, manage Kubernetes port forwards, integrate Cloudflare Tunnels, and kill processes with one click.
FineTune, a macOS menu bar app for per-app volume control, multi-device output, audio routing, and 10-band EQ. Free and open-source alternative to SoundSource.
☀️ A macOS menu bar app that gives you more control over Night Shift.

Free, open-source external monitor control for macOS: a lightweight menu bar app with sharp HiDPI/Retina scaling (no more blurry or tiny text), DDC brightness, presets, and virtual displays. A free alternative to BetterDisplay and Lunar, including features they charge for.
Menu bar manager for macOS 26

⌘⌘ - A lightweight, native macOS screenshot tool that lives in your menu bar. Double-tap ⌘ Command to capture any region of your screen — instantly copied to clipboard, or annotate first with pen and mosaic tools.
Menu Bar RSS reader for macOS
Glanceable market data for macOS
Lightweight macOS desktop system monitor widget — live CPU, memory, disk, network, battery & process metrics. Swift + SwiftUI.
A native, local-first clipboard history manager for macOS.

Keep your MacBook awake with the lid closed, on battery, with no external display. A native menu-bar app that uses pmset disablesleep, with an auto-off timer and a battery-floor cutoff so it can't drain your Mac. The open-source, MIT alternative to Amphetamine.
Lightweight Dynamic Island for macOS with AI coding agent notifications
A macOS voice, screenshot, clipboard, and coding-agent workbench.
Open-source macOS menu bar app to monitor Vercel deployment status in real time (build/ready/error).
Menu bar app that finds and frees the disk space dev build artifacts and caches hog on macOS. Free, open source, notarized, zero telemetry.
Your Mac as a key fob: SSH keys that live in the Secure Enclave, open only the doors they're badged for, and take one touch to use.

Voice dictation menu-bar app for macOS. Press a hotkey, speak, transcript appears at the cursor. Whisper runs locally via WhisperKit on Apple Silicon — no audio, text, or telemetry leaves your Mac. MIT, Swift.
Native macOS menu bar app for tmux session management — attach, live preview, Keep Awake (caffeinate detection), templates, global hotkeys.
A macOS hotkey that opens your terminal at the right repo with your coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, …) already running. Free, open source, local-only.
Menu bar app that types your script into any app - one block per hotkey press, as real keystrokes at a human pace. For demos, screencasts, and presentations.

Fig/Kiro-CLI-style command completion for Zsh   via a native macOS floating panel — matches   git/docker/kubectl/npm/aws and 40+ other CLIs   against hand-picked static tables (no daemon, no   network, no AI).
